How to use this calculator

  1. Enter home price, down payment, note interest rate and the remaining inputs.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How va mortgage is calculated

The estimate subtracts the down payment and amortizes the balance over equal monthly payments. Program fees, insurance and eligibility rules are included only when a separate input explicitly provides them. Formula: Financed balance = price − down payment + entered funding fee; payment follows fixed-rate amortization. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.

Financed balance = price − down payment + entered funding fee; payment follows fixed-rate amortization.
A worked example

A $350,000 home with $20,000 down at 6% for 30 years is about $1,979 monthly before any entered funding fee.

Assumptions & useful context

Funding-fee rate is an editable assumption and defaults to zero. Confirm the applicable fee and any exemption with the lender; taxes and home insurance are excluded.

Financial projections use your assumptions. Actual returns, lender terms, fees and tax rules can differ; these results do not guarantee a future outcome.

Frequently asked questions

VA Mortgage Calculator: what does the result include?

It is the loan payment and any explicit premium included in the selected calculator. Property tax, homeowners insurance, maintenance and association costs may add to it.

VA Mortgage Calculator: which assumptions matter most?

No. The user-entered rates and fees are assumptions; confirm program rules and any required insurance or funding charges with the lender.
